name: F-16C, military power only, with 4 × AIM-120 (AIM-120C-DCS)
description: BLUE-1 as the DCS AI flies it for dcs_live.py: no afterburner, AIM-120C-DCS. Train the agent on this against F-16C-DCS (the DCS AI in combat uses afterburner).

sources.WPN_COUNT: standard BVR loadout in this project
sources.RCS_M2: commonly cited open-source frontal estimate (≈ 1.2 m²)
sources.SPEED_CMDS: the action set existing checkpoints were trained with; 460 m/s added in SIM_REV 14 (Mach 1.5 at 9 km, the DCS AI's dash in combat)
sources.CLIMB_FPA_LO: holds speed on a 3 km climb (measured)
